_comment: Versioned deployment manifest for Stellar testnet. Pakta_Division_Trabajo.md §7 requires the Proof-of-Payable Builder and the Settlement Adapter to read asset_contract_id from a manifest rather than hardcoding it, so that registration_digest is always bound to the deployment it was issued for. Public identifiers only — no seeds, ever.

asset._comment: Demo asset issued by Pakta for the hackathon. NOT Circle USDC. Pakta_Plan_Implementacion.md §2.5: going to mainnet is a change of this manifest, not of code.

payableGate._comment: Capped vault. v4 adds upgrade(), so this contract id is stable from here on: code changes are an upgrade, not a redeploy. Also: issuer-signed attest_lifecycle, revocation V2 (reason is signed), a 7-day ceiling on proof windows, set_admin/set_treasury, and expire_batch.

payableGateV3._comment: Superseded by v4. Its whole float (89,000 USDC) was recovered to the treasury with its own withdraw(), which is what that function is for: nothing was left trapped when the gate was retired.

payableGateV2._comment: Superseded by v3. Kept because earlier functional-test transactions reference it. Its Config has no treasury field, so it cannot be upgraded in place.

payableGateScaffold._comment: HU-D1-01 toolchain scaffold. The pinned registration/revocation digest parity vectors are bound to this contract id.

trustlines._comment: Friendbot only funds XLM. Every account that receives the demo USDC needed an explicit change-trust first — the Semana 2 risk flagged in Pakta_Division_Trabajo.md §4.

verification._comment: Transactions proving the asset path works end to end, before any contract logic exists.
verification.sacTransferNote: 5000.0000000 USDC (50000000000 units) distributor -> VEN-001, the exact INV-001 amount from Pakta_Documento_Maestro.md §25. Emitted a `transfer` event, which is the shape the Event Indexer will consume.
verification.functionalCheck: scripts/testnet-settle.ts: signed register, substituted-recipient rejected on-chain, exact-amount settle, double settle rejected, non-executor settle rejected.
